name: Campingplatz Schliersee
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Schliersee combines alpine serenity with the allure of a crystal-clear mountain lake. Featuring modern sanitary facilities, comfortable pitches, and immediate access to diverse recreational activities, the site delivers high standards year-round.

Hikers and winter sports enthusiasts benefit from prime opportunities, from summer alpine ascents to snowy ski slopes and cross-country trails nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Schliersee offers year-round camping pleasure between the lakeshore and majestic alpine peaks.
